starting_state: Prepared colourless alcoholic sample using the source's liquid-sample alternative before DNP delivery; planned alcohol range 2–3 mL, not image-calibrated.
scope: DNP reagent delivery only; sample dissolution and any subsequent source-required warming/cooling are omitted. No immediate completed precipitate is forced.

clips.name: dnp_delivery
clips.action: Deliver a few drops of the source's alcoholic DNP reagent into the existing prepared alcoholic sample, with tip above rim, then stop.
clips.state_before: Fresh colourless prepared alcoholic sample before DNP, not a phenol-tested sample.
clips.state_after: Reagent enters the existing sample. A yellow/orange/orange-red precipitate is conditional on sample and source conditions, including later warming/cooling if needed; do not force an instant endpoint.

reuse_rationale: Same visible low colourless transparent charge and apparatus before reagent delivery. The 2–3 mL alcoholic preparation is an independent fresh sample; the image carries no identity, solvent or measured-volume proof. No phenol reaction state is reused.
